chunks: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali b. al-Husayn al-Sa'd Abadi narrated to us from Ahmad b. Abi Abdillah al-Barqi from his father from Wahb b. Wahb from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them) from Ali (peace be upon him). He said:

The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family), when he saw a fresh fruit, would kiss it and place it on his eyes and his mouth, then say: "O Allah, just as You showed us its beginning in wellness, show us its ending in wellness."

key_terms.الفاكهة الجديدة: fresh/new fruit, referring to seasonal produce appearing for the first time
key_terms.عافية: wellness, good health, safety from affliction

ai.seo_question: What supplication did the Prophet Muhammad say when he saw fresh fruit?
ai.summary: This hadith describes a sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (S) when encountering fresh seasonal fruit. He would kiss it and place it on his eyes and mouth as a gesture of gratitude for Allah's provision, then recite a supplication asking Allah to let them enjoy the fruit in good health from its first appearance to its last. This practice reflects the prophetic etiquette of expressing thankfulness for divine blessings, particularly the bounties of nature.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him
